items.text: Want to offer health benefits to full-time staff but not part-time? An ICHRA, also called a CHOICE Arrangement, lets you set different allowances by employee class, such as full-time, part-time, seasonal or work location. Each employee then picks an individual plan that fits them. Some class setups carry minimum-size rules, so we help you set them up correctly. Licensed in 11 states. Call (571) 354-0146.
